ITA-9.2.23 hṛdbastiḥ हृद्बस्तिः
Therapeutic retention of oil over cardiac region
A procedure which involves holding medicated oil over the cardiac region for a specific duration.

.34 hṛdyam हृद्यम्
Substance enhancing health and functioning of the heart, mindpleasing

ITA-5.76.44 hṝdayopasaraṇam/ hṝdagrahaḥvamanavyāpat हॄदयोपसरणम्/ हॄदग्रहः-वमनव्यापत्
Condition of tightness in precordial region, due to faulty emetic therapy

ITA-5.76.75 hṝdayopasaraṇam/ hṝdagrahavirecanavyāpat हॄदयोपसरणम्/ हॄदग्रहविरेचनव्यापत्
Condition of migration to precordial region due to faulty purgative therapy

ITA-5.76.35 hṝdrogi vamanasya vyapadaḥ हॄद्रोगि वमनस्य व्यापदः
Condition caused by emetic therapy administered to person with heart disease
